name: Summer Design Studios
street_address: Providence Career and Technical Academy, 41 Fricker Street
description_short: A six week design program for Providence County high school students at Providence Career and Technical Academy. Teens work in Design/Build or Creative Change studios on real projects for nonprofits and city agencies, from research to building structures for public spaces.
notes: Free, and eligible students are paid for taking part. Open to Providence County high school students in grades 8 to 11 during 2025 to 2026 (grades 9 to 12 in 2026 to 2027); 40 places, by application. Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 9:00 to 3:00 (no Wednesdays), with breakfast from 8:30. Applications for 2026 are closed; the youth page lists Summer 2027 without dates.
